rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour and its relationship to obstacle presence needed to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. SG-3 establishes that behaviour as the evaluation subject, while H-3 supports the obstacle-absence condition and declared operational scope. P does not expand the phenomenon to include sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing requirements.
determining_elements: “Braking behaviour of the ego vehicle” is itself the behaviour targeted by SG-3, rather than merely a mechanism affecting evaluation.
“Whether braking occurs without a corresponding obstacle in front” directly reflects H-3’s hazardous event of stopping despite no obstacle being present.
The declared straight-ahead urban-driving scope at 50 km/h, in good weather and without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3’s operational situation.
P does not incorporate obstacle-detection processes, controller responses, warnings, redundancy, or the detection and braking-response deadlines listed in the requirements.
